main.description: Policy for a space governed by a member list maintained by the PDS. A user is authorized for an access kind when the corresponding public flag is set, or when their member-list entry has the corresponding read or write boolean set. The member list itself is not part of this object and is managed through com.atproto.memberspace.putMember, removeMember, and listMembers.

publicRead.description: Authorize anyone to read, rather than only members. No delegation token is required.

publicWrite.description: Track and forward notifications for any user's writes, rather than only members'.

items.description: An OAuth client_id permitted to access the space.

allowedApps.description: The applications the authority authorizes, evaluated against the attested client_id of a verified client attestation. Any application may read the space when omitted. Does not apply to writes.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the authority's own repo in the space.

publishMembers.description: Publish the member list to readers as com.atproto.memberspace.member records in the authority's own repo in the space.
